text:
kenji: heads-up: during the Q5 shadow run for veridian we saw kana+han coalescence on KR+JP mixed inputs. float detok looks fine, q5 detok concatenates kana into adjacent han clusters. sample below.

kenji: sample input: 
`서울역 근처에 있는 新宿 잡은 가게에 갔어요.`
float detok: `서울역 근처에 있는 新宿에 잡은 가게에 갔어요.`
q5 detok:   `서울역 근처에 있는新宿잡은 가게에 갔어요.`

suzanne: ouch. that removes spacing between han and kana which breaks downstream srt alignment. what's the tokenizer/version/config?

kenji: tokenizer: redwood-tokenizer@v2.14, config: preserve_zwj=false, joiner_policy=auto, locale_hint=ko-JP (legacy test rig). quant: q5 symmetric-per-row fallback=per-channel.

hao: do we see token count diffs? if token indices shift we might also get embedding aliasing, but if token count decreases it's tokenizer.

kenji: token counts: float=20, q5=16 for the example above. reduced by 4.

miguel: noted. v2.14 had a patch to join small kana runs to previous han cluster to reduce BPE fragmentation. probably too aggressive for mixed locale. I'll diff the joiner heuristics.

yara: starting tokenizer-only smoke across 5k mixed KR/JP sentences comparing v2.13 vs v2.14. will post summary. ETA ~8m.

(eval-bot): nightly-smoke summary 2026-07-11T09:03Z 
- dataset: mix_kr_jp_5k
- v2.13 avg tokens/sent: 18.9
- v2.14 avg tokens/sent: 17.1
- pct sentences with token-count drop >=2: 12.4%
- p-value (paired): 0.003

suzanne: that aligns with our BLEU drop. i ran a small translation check on 200 samples: float BLEU=32.0, q5+w/ v2.14 BLEU=28.6.

hao: to rule out quant remap: can someone run encode() from the model's tokenizer implementation (inside the runtime) on the same input and compare to external tokenizer binary? run: `python -c "from runtime.tokenizer import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer('v2.14').encode(sample))"`

kenji: I ran that: runtime encode matches external v2.14 output (so tokenizer path inside model is same).

miguel: i located the commit: `tokenize: treat_isolated_kana_as_joining=true` (accidentally flipped). quick revert patch locally flips the flag back and re-runs smoke on the 200-sample BLEU check.

(miguel): patch run results: token counts back to baseline for the example, avg tokens/sent on sample restored from 17.1 -> 18.8, BLEU for q5+patched-tokenizer = 31.0 (float=32.0).

(eval-bot): adhoc-run veridian-q5-shadow vs veridian-float on smallset 200
- BLEU float: 32.0
- BLEU q5 (v2.14 patched tokenizer): 31.0
- detok-checksum (float): 0x5a3c2d7f
- detok-checksum (q5/raw v2.14): 0x7b9e1f2a
- detok-checksum (q5/patched): 0x5a3c2d7c

suzanne: checksum diff shows tokenizer was the main driver. small residual BLEU gap expected from quantization. new plan: block Q5 shadow rollout that bundles redwood-tokenizer@v2.14 until we ship the patch.

h ao: also add a test into the bring-up harness to assert token-count parity and detok-checksum parity thresholds between float and quant shadows for locale-mixed sets.

kenji: agreed. can someone open a PR to revert the joiner flip and add tests? add an acceptance test: for mix_kr_jp_5k ensure avg tokens/sent delta <= 0.5 and detok-checksum Hamming distance <= 8.

miguel: PR #4982 opened: revert `treat_isolated_kana_as_joining` and add mix_kr_jp and mix_ja_zh test vectors. cc: @suzanne for test expectations.

yara: smoke harness run posted to GH action. infra-bot queued a q5 rebuild once PR merges.

(infra-bot): queued job: q5-shadow-rebuild after merge #4982. estimated build: 45m.

suzanne: after merge we'll re-run full BLEU suite. if clean we'll un-block shadow; otherwise keep blocked. documenting action items: 1) revert patch + tests (miguel), 2) postmortem note about locale-hint misuse (kenji), 3) add bring-up checklist item to compare token counts between float and quant (suzanne).

kenji: filing the postmortem now and adding the checklist item. Also renaming any test harness that sets locale_hint=ko-JP for kr/jp mixes to avoid accidental hint mismatch.

hao: one more follow-up: we should run an embedding-index parity check after rebuild to confirm no index aliasing introduces drift. i can run that if infra posts artifacts.

miguel: merging PR after one nit fix. will ping when q5 artifacts ready.

kenji: thanks all. lowering P1->P2; Q5 shadow remains blocked until CI validations pass. :thumbsup:
